title: SMProfile-JobResponse payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/job-response.json 2.0.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

job_response_id.description: Identity of the job response: its own number from the source system (MES). It is never built from other keys.

work_response_ref.description: The work response this job response is part of (PART_OF).

job_order_ref.description: The job order this response answers (RESPONDS_TO).

work_master_ref.description: The work master the job ran by (FOR_WORK_MASTER).

machine_ref.description: The machine (Equipment) the job ran on (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT).

material_lot_ref.description: The lot the job consumed or produced (ACTUAL_MATERIAL).

tool_ref.description: The tool (physical asset) the job used (ACTUAL_PHYSICAL_ASSET).

person_ref.description: The person who ran the job (ACTUAL_PERSONNEL) — the pseudonymous person_id, never a name.

status.description: Job state as the source names it (ISA-95 JobState).

equipment_class_ref.description: The EquipmentClass (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT; ISA-95 JobResponse → EquipmentClass). Optional.

material_class_ref.description: The MaterialClass (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialClass). Optional.

article_ref.description: The Article (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialDefinition). Optional.

article_revision.description: The revision of the article that was built or used, where the source's article number carries none (a PLM part number with revision A). Empty when the number itself names the revision (at SAP dddd.1).

quant_ref.description: The Quant (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

personnel_class_ref.description: The PersonnelClass (ACTUAL_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 JobResponse → PersonnelClass). Optional.

physical_asset_class_ref.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (ACTUAL_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 JobResponse → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

work_directive_ref.description: The WorkDirective (EXECUTED_DIRECTIVE; ISA-95 JobResponse → WorkDirective). Optional.

workflow_specification_ref.description: The WorkflowSpecification (FOR_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION; ISA-95 JobResponse → WorkflowSpecification). Optional.

workflow_specification_node_ref.description: The WorkflowSpecificationNode (FOR_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION_NODE; ISA-95 JobResponse → WorkflowSpecificationNode). Optional.

inspection_lot_ref.description: The InspectionLot — the test result of a material actual (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → MaterialActual → TestResult). Optional.

personnel_test_result_ref.description: The TestResult of a person (qualification test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → PersonnelActual → TestResult). Optional.

equipment_test_result_ref.description: The TestResult of a machine (equipment capability test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → EquipmentActual → TestResult). Optional.

physical_asset_test_result_ref.description: The TestResult of a tool (physical asset capability test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 JobResponse → PhysicalAssetActual → TestResult). Optional.

job_response_list_ref.description: The JobResponseList this JobResponse is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 JobResponseList MADE_UP_OF JobResponse). Optional.

work_type.description: ISA-95 work type (B2MML WorkType, the OperationsType code list; Part 4; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).
